title: Thai Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Thai-inspired stir-fry made with crunchy vegetables, protein-rich chicken, and a hint of Ukrainian spices.
instructions: Heat stir-fry oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add bell peppers and mushrooms to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add yeast (if using) and dill to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with vegetables and spices.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until sauce has thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
Season with high protein soy sauce to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
